About me

Meet Obadare Olabiyi.

Helping Businesses Work Smarter Through CRM and Automation.

I'm the founder of Daret Digitals and a CRM and business automation specialist. I help businesses configure CRM systems, organize their databases, automate repetitive tasks, improve lead management, and connect the applications they use every day.

Every project starts with how your business actually works. From there I build a system that is organized, tested, documented, and easy for your team to use.

  • Understanding business requirements
  • Creating customized CRM structures
  • Organizing customer data
  • Improving lead management
  • Automating repetitive workflows
  • Connecting relevant business tools
  • Testing and documenting completed systems
  • Communicating clearly throughout projects

My goal is to help businesses spend less time managing repetitive tasks and more time focusing on customers, operations, and growth.
